entities.name: Zhang Xiaoni
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zhang Xiaoni is a female Chinese basketball player who was part of the teams that won gold medals at the 2002 Asian Games and the 2006 Asian Games. She also competed at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing.
